lock_protocol.acquire: mkdir /workspace/locks/comfy.lock (atomic; non-zero exit = held), retry ~10s backoff up to lock_timeout (default 900s)
lock_protocol.queue_gate: GET /queue; wait until running and pending are empty before POST /prompt
lock_protocol.release: rm -f holder; rmdir <lock_dir> in a finally block
lock_protocol.stale_action: log 'stale lock taken over' and take it (rm -rf + mkdir)
failure_modes: crash between acquire and finally leaves the lock until the 20-minute stale timer
two agents racing on a stale lock: last mkdir wins, loser backs off and re-gates on /queue
rmdir fails on a leftover holder file: we rm -f holder first
staleness uses the box's own date/stat, so local clock skew is irrelevant
lock_protocol.verified: exercised end to end by the proven run (acquire, holder write, queue gate, release)
